official_get.message:
test: propagate prepared-input fixture errors across child tests

Return a private boxed-error Result from input and prepared_request and
propagate every call through the existing prepared-input and compaction
test modules. Preserve all11 tests and45 assertions, including the actual
child environment/selector/exit contract, negative identity cases and
the complete compaction held-file observation helper.

This separate follow-up removes an ordinary-helper expect introduced by
the earlier Windows fixture correction; preserve that frozen source and
its review history. No lint relaxation, new skip, fallback or dependency
is introduced. Source review and exact patch-preservation checks passed.
Native Rust, Windows, formatter and strict Clippy gates remain pending CI.
